base: satsuma-core-2.2.37-duzeltilmis archive of 2026-11-18 (no git history, docs and release/ folder in the archive)
source_tests: 2334 passed, 24 skipped, 13 failed + 4 collection errors on an Ubuntu 24.04 container (Python 3.13). Every failure but one needs PyQt5/PyQt6, which the container lacks; the other is satsuma-core-windows, which still imports the retired satsuma.ram.engine (Windows RAM-ClamAV removal not done).
rpm_build_note: rpmbuild is not available where this source was prepared; build on Fedora with: SATSUMA_RPM_BUILD_ROOT=$(mktemp -d) bash packaging/build.sh
publisher_signature: unavailable; package built locally and not signed
behavior_changes: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.38.md: account-file writes judged by what they changed; account guard covers empty/DES hashes, a second UID 0, 65534 and dynamic users; deep engine starts and connects; reader reads before any writer opens the database and restarts at the end of installation; operator device decision and IP unblock no longer crash; rpm-ostree paths (kargs, /etc sysctl overrides, packaged definitions, rpm-ostree as package manager, no USB kernel argument on ostree); script file modes fixed in the spec; maintenance kit (satsuma-admin bakim, satsuma-maintenance.timer, tam-kontrol covers the whole product); 2.2.39: integrity and quarantine walks follow only links root alone could have placed (Fedora Atomic /opt, /home, /root, /usr/local), quarantine accepts the /var roots of Atomic; 2.2.40: ostree first boot clears Satsuma start limits before %posttrans; maintenance kit accepts units whose condition does not hold and reports failed units outside the enabled list; 2.2.41: DHCP, NTP, TeamViewer and AnyDesk go through the Suricata queue (no channel outside it but loopback); RAM-001 judges sandboxed programs (Snap, Flatpak) by the running file; desktop enrollment copies the Atomic group into /etc/group and the launcher shows why it could not open; 2.2.42: on-access scanning watches the real folder behind /home (Fedora Atomic), retired components are not listed, OPNsense without a log is "not configured"; 2.2.43: folder walkers open first and create only missing folders (no EEXIST audit noise); 2.2.44: dnsmasq returns in its own network namespace (satsuma-dns, 169.254.53.2:53, never loopback); the DNS lock redirects every non-loopback query there; its upstream queries reach only OpenDNS and only through the Suricata queue (forward chain); no list is downloaded by the product, user lists are fetched once on request and kept read-only and signed; the distribution dnsmasq is masked and its configuration moved to evidence; 2.2.45: panel redesigned around the user: Durum (verdict, what waits for you with the button that resolves it, protection layers, last day), Olanlar (one feed, repeats folded, what happened / what Satsuma did / what you can do), Koruma (every switch with its real state and one sentence), Sağlık (one-click repair through the maintenance kit), Ayarlar; one administrator lock for all pages; every earlier table under an optional Uzman görünümü; 2.2.46: SATSUMA-FILELESS-002 every few seconds was Satsuma itself: the Sistem kökeni page ran bootc status every 3 s and bootc runs from a temporary /tmp/.tmpXXXXXX copy; the page no longer polls, the reader keeps the report ten minutes, and a bootc self-copy proven by the same process exec of /usr/bin/bootc with the same arguments is not recorded; 2.2.47: the old design is gone (no Uzman görünümü, no management or overview page); every earlier menu is a tab of nine sections: Durum, Olanlar, Antivirüs (ClamAV/rkhunter/chkrootkit scans with what ClamAV scanned and found, quarantine, memory defence, file integrity), Güvenlik duvarı (settings, address and range blocks such as 192.168.0.0/16 in the owned table satsuma_netblock, block history, devices, DNS, traffic, OTX, VPN), Uygulama denetimi, Koruma, Sağlık (TPM and boot under Açılış, TPM ve paketler), Kayıtlar (all records of both databases in one readable list, repeats folded) and Ayarlar; DeepSeek rules are tested before review, a refused reply is corrected once with Satsuma's reasons, one rule covers one variant and the rules already present are named so each request brings a new one; 2.2.48: unhide no longer reports threads as hidden processes (a TID whose thread group is listed in /proc is a thread); open hidden-process findings are verified again after every scan and on request, threads and vanished processes closed with the reason; a still-hidden process from an open finding can be ended from Antivirüs (pidfd, SIGTERM then SIGKILL, never a thread, kernel thread or Satsuma; recorded as an action); deep-engine records read as sentences (deep_engine_evidence catalogued, review states in Turkish, rule titles from the rule files); 2.2.49: the rules page says what each rule does (stops the program under the central policy, only reports as a plain activity indicator, stops only when automatic stopping is on, or follows the DeepSeek proposal) instead of counting kill actions in rule files, shows whether automatic stopping is on, and how the last 24 hours of automatic stops ended (stopped, program already gone before the signal, refused by a safety check, failed); 2.2.50: address ranges can be always allowed (IPv4 up to /8, IPv6 up to /16): no automatic path blocks them (guard no-PTR flood rule, OTX connection kill, Suricata alerts, subnet limit, automatic network response), addresses already blocked inside are lifted, a manual range block that overlaps is refused, allowing asks for the password again; satsuma-firewall-watch.timer checks every minute that each Satsuma nftables table exists while its owning service is active and restarts that service when it does not (at most three repairs per group in 30 minutes, every repair recorded); 2.2.51 (stabilisation phase 1a): a newly blocked domain no longer restarts dnsmasq; it is written to a signed added.hosts that dnsmasq reads through addn-hosts and re-reads on SIGHUP (sent to the verified dnsmasq PID), so DNS keeps answering; the full list with subdomains is reloaded at most every 30 minutes, as removals already were; 2.2.52: a followed auditd rotation is no longer recorded as AUDIT_SOURCE_CHANGED (it was, every rotation); temporary-scan errors keep the reason and errno and the kind is named Geçici dosya taraması hataları (it said browser memory); OTX domain errors name the domain; error lines in Kayıtlar read as sentences and a warning-level error is listed as Uyarı; the record detail starts at its first line on every selection; the flow sender keeps events for a full or restarting rule engine in a bounded ordered backlog (20000) instead of losing them, and a loss is counted once (it raised both Olay gönderilemedi and Toplayıcı olay düşürdü)
ostree_field_report: 2.2.39 on Fedora Atomic: integrity verified (536 files), core services running; first boot needed four attempts (start limits), self-health DEGRADED on satsuma-core-dns and a competing suricata.service
